summary_ja: HPCI公式databaseではGCCとPythonが各16資源、CUDAとNVIDIA HPC SDKが各10資源に登録される一方、performance analyzerは最多のAMD uProfでも4資源、Arm Forge・VTune等は1～2資源でした。compile可能性に比べ、bottleneckを同じ方法で診断するtool coverageが狭いことが示唆されます。登録の完全性と更新日は未確認なので、共通portability CIとtool readiness testが必要です。Consensusは未完了です。
summary_en: The HPCI official database registers GCC and Python on 16 resources each and CUDA and NVIDIA HPC SDK on ten each, while performance-analyzer coverage is narrower: AMD uProf spans four resources and Arm Forge, VTune, and others one or two. This suggests a gap between the ability to compile and the ability to diagnose bottlenecks consistently. Registry completeness and freshness remain unverified, so common portability CI and tool-readiness tests are needed. Consensus is incomplete.

sections.title_en: Compiler and interpreter registrations across HPCI resources
sections.summary_ja: 共通toolchainとvendor SDKのcoverageを分けて評価します。
sections.summary_en: Evaluate common toolchains separately from vendor SDK coverage.

items.name_en: GCC/Python are broad while accelerator and vector SDKs are architecture-specific
items.statement_ja: available flag付き登録はGCCとPythonが各16資源、Julia 11、CUDAとNVIDIA HPC SDKが各10、Intel compiler 8、AMD compiler 5、NEC Vector Engine SDK 4、富士通compiler 2でした。共通front-endがあっても、OpenMP offload、CUDA、ROCm、vectorization、architecture flag、library linkは資源ごとに異なります。
items.statement_en: Registrations carrying the available flag span 16 resources each for GCC and Python, 11 for Julia, ten each for CUDA and NVIDIA HPC SDK, eight for Intel compilers, five for AMD compilers, four for NEC Vector Engine SDK, and two for Fujitsu compilers. Common front ends do not make OpenMP offload, CUDA, ROCm, vectorization, architecture flags, or library links uniform.
items.hpci_relevance_ja: application資産の移行費は言語対応の有無ではなく、build recipe、directive、backend、依存library、性能回復工数で見積もるべきです。
items.hpci_relevance_en: Application migration cost should be estimated from build recipes, directives, backends, dependencies, and performance-recovery effort rather than language support alone.
adoption_conditions_ja: 共通application corpusを全toolchainで継続buildする。
compiler version、target flag、runtime、offload featureを機械可読化する。
adoption_conditions_en: Continuously build a common application corpus with every toolchain.
Record compiler versions, target flags, runtimes, and offload features in machine-readable form.
Separate compile, correctness, and performance gates.

sections.summary_ja: build環境より狭い解析tool coverageを、移植支援のriskとして扱います。
sections.summary_en: Treat analyzer coverage narrower than build environments as a porting-support risk.

items.name_ja: 同一手法での性能診断は資源横断で未整備
items.name_en: Uniform cross-resource performance diagnosis is not established
items.statement_ja: available flag付きperformance analyzer登録はAMD uProf 4資源、Arm Forge 2、Intel VTune系は個別entryで各2、Vampir、Linaro Forge、NVIDIA profiler、Darshan等は各1資源でした。database未掲載は非対応を意味しませんが、compiler登録より明らかに少なく、共通のCPU/GPU/communication/I/O診断手順は確認できません。
items.statement_en: Performance-analyzer registrations carrying the available flag span four resources for AMD uProf, two for Arm Forge, two each for separate Intel VTune entries, and one each for Vampir, Linaro Forge, NVIDIA profiler, Darshan, and others. Absence does not prove lack of support, but coverage is visibly narrower than compiler registration and no uniform CPU/GPU/communication/I/O diagnostic workflow is established.
items.hpci_relevance_ja: 次期systemの受入には、同じbenchmarkを同じtrace schemaで測り、center横断比較できるperformance engineering基盤が必要です。
items.hpci_relevance_en: Acceptance of future systems needs a performance-engineering layer that measures the same benchmarks with a common trace schema across centers.
adoption_conditions_ja: CPU、GPU、MPI、I/O、energyの最小tool setを定義する。
tool overheadとcounter availabilityをarchitecture別に検証する。
trace metadataと解析結果を共通schemaで保存する。
adoption_conditions_en: Define a minimum tool set for CPU, GPU, MPI, I/O, and energy.
Validate tool overhead and counter availability by architecture.
Store trace metadata and analysis results under a common schema.
